message.content: A direct commercial flight from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) to Miami International Airport (MIA) typically takes **about 5½ to 6 hours** under normal weather conditions. Wind patterns, air traffic control routing, and aircraft speed variations can shift this slightly—sometimes as short as ~5¼ hours if tailwinds prevail, or up to ~6¾ hours when headwinds slow the cruise phase.
